meaning: Selected implemented public interfaces and explicit limits. Package audit inspects command registration and local references; roadmap acceptance and project readiness remain separate. Wave 3 bounded interfaces are locally integrated and individually native-tested; the final combined native run is blocked by Xcode license acceptance.

limits: Actual clock/state/raster evidence and bounded comparisons remain descriptive; circular comparisons apply only to full loops.
Held-out low-contrast and excessive-motion cases can be missed. Empty warnings cannot establish observed readability.
Finite activity uses linear diagnostics with no circular predecessor or join. Typed activity requirement evidence explicitly rejects finite scenes pending P06.
Binds and checks picture/action/PCM identity; retiming and listening remain explicit. No waveform stretching or new sound generation is implied.
Explicit pcm or macos-afconvert backend; bounded mono/stereo integer PCM, MP3 and AAC/ALAC sources with declared raw format. Core Audio discovery does not establish successful execution.
Immutable original and 48 kHz PCM24 preparation retain source, decoder and recipe identity. Lossy originals remain lossy; no audition, entitlement, loudness or true-peak claim.

Source preparations remain project-contained and pin their first origin. Typed audio-library materialization preserves prior receipt bytes while copying active dependencies into a destination project.
Explicit stable local media root, immutable source versions and destination-contained source/review snapshots. No generation, loudness measurement or collection curation.
Audition rendering does not establish listening. Acceptance needs an explicit current full-source observation; the public replay stays unaccepted.
Stage-specific, input-bound readiness consumes exact typed evidence; it cannot infer omitted artistic intentions.
Observed expectations remain unreviewed until actual artifact observations are recorded. Proof/review delivery can retain explicit gaps.
Overview/next use pure assessment; explicit evidence/coverage/preflight retain persistence. Missing exact movie decode cache stays unknown on reads.
Authored expectations and workload are not artistic observations.
Legacy prose migration requires an explicit mapping proposal.
Static saved crops share the existing clock; missing scenery and successful composition still require production work and visual review.
Failed alpha audits retain the measured frame, heatmap and bounded coordinates at the reported reduced resolution; semantic paint ownership and artistic acceptance remain unmeasured.
The prepare adapter dispatches init/inspect/check/edit/build/place/proof operations.
Explicit local masks and reconstructed source paint are required; no automatic segmentation or hidden-paint generation.
Preparation proofs are isolated studies, not full-scene readiness.
Acyclic explicit layer responses and receiver-local illumination; no feedback physics or automatic light inference.
Raster and package checks do not establish artistic lighting approval.
Milestones 1–3 provide explicit observations, translation correction, bounded classical tracking and comparisons.
Learned tracking, general deformation and contact constraints remain separate follow-ups.
Actual encode/decode requires the configured native backend.
Completed outputs, exact editions and current selections remain distinct; presentation does not imply human approval.
Records and reconciles local request/output identities; does not submit provider requests or grant spending authority.
Bounded test and synthetic replay evidence is separate from autonomous agent trials and film review.
FOLLOW-01/02 remain evidence-triggered work after film pilots; no production command is promised here.
Reports bind deliveries/entries with optional time. Resolution never passes artistic gates.
Overview schema 2 is bounded; --details retains full evidence. Hash/coverage work can still be expensive.
Selected delivery entries and working inputs have separate identities; missing or changing components remain diagnosed. Assessment hashes are query freshness aids, not saved receipts.
Clock changes do not retime tracks or sound. Fulfillment preserves scope and review fields.
Full loop rendering with interval playback, exact media and source auditions. Playback is approximately synchronized and device-dependent.
Benchmarks report unknown native/compose costs explicitly. Unverified PIDs are never signaled.
Exact source pixels and remapped anchors/sockets. Finishing and binding participants need coordinated preparation.
Ordered local JSON/YAML objects, typed literal values, explicit array replacement. Existing validated recipes remain the execution contract.
Only recognized unreferenced generated bundles enter reversible trash. No automatic permanent purge, source deduplication or artistic approval inference.
Static inserts, manually authored source-space masks and explicit return registration.
No provider submission, automatic segmentation, perspective warp or animated clipping engine.
Sizing describes pixel demand; painted integration remains a visual observation.
C1/C2 immutable local definitions, compiler/source closure, shared-engine static lowering and exact role/source proofs; technical local entry only.

Static named states with painted roots and compatible drawings. Broader animation controls, production artwork and Phase 1/P00 acceptance remain outside this slice; scene instances use the separate instance contract.
Opt-in project next --guided and exact working/review/release/revision/edition/view inspection consume native pipeline and pure assessment. No project mutation or inferred observation.
WF-02/03 stage/action inspection remains advisory. Native packets and optional outcomes have separate contracts; WF-06/07 operator trials/adoption and model-operation guidance expansion remain open.
Fresh native intent, unperformed review and iteration inputs preserve exact subjects, origins and hashes. Missing creative choices keep ready_to_run false.
Complete iteration packets expose native preflight; execution still needs explicit recorder identity. Preparation performs no capture, render, provider call or selection change.
Opt-in --guidance off|auto|full defaults off. Auto uses operation-local facts; full assesses a compatible exact subject or reports why reassessment is unavailable.
Native results, errors, exit status and output ownership are preserved. Guidance failure never converts a successful mutation into a production failure; no observation or gate pass is inferred.

Project-contained pinned art, independent placement/static controls/variants, explicit receiver contacts and restorable scene/catalog transactions. Existing raster receipts can bind exact model subjects.
Adoption is explicit and conservative: changed drawing/socket/registration/control interfaces or nested pins conflict. No live upgrades, automatic light transport or motion-evidence claim.
Broader model/character/whole-scene acceptance remains open; final combined native validation is blocked by Xcode license acceptance.
Opt-in finite shots and explicit local cycles share the existing evaluator. Integer duration and --start-frame preserve exact output identity; movies exclude the separately inspectable endpoint.

Legacy loops remain compatible. Rational native fps, finite movie repeats and nonzero finite audio ranges are unsupported. Finite activity is linear diagnostic only; typed requirement evidence rejects finite scenes pending P06. P00 production acceptance and P04-P06 remain open; final combined native validation is blocked by Xcode license acceptance.
48 kHz mono/stereo integer PCM metering reports LUFS, 4x true peak, sample peaks/RMS and mono cancellation. Source and unclipped decoded AAC presentation samples have separate identities.

Requested AAC bitrate keeps the 256000 default and is checked against actual format-specific capability. 320000 passed native encode/decode; the recorded 384000 trial rejected before rendering without fallback.

Selected deterministic reference checks passed; full independent conformance and auditions remain open. Final combined native validation is blocked by Xcode license acceptance. No automatic normalization, universal loudness target, curation or release approval.
